title: /chart's live counsel walks codemother's own trees by default
intention: `live counsel` walks codemother_<nexus>_nodes when no owner is named, and its served payload says which owner's tree it walked.
why: Measured 2026-11-05: skills/chart/live.py _counsel passes no owner unless argv names one, so tree.counsel falls back to tree.OWNER = 'chart'. The parent 2b3d842bc118 moves codemother's learning to codemother_<nexus>_nodes (Akien 2026-11-05: 'codemother's learning goes in its own tables'); left on 'chart', counsel would walk an empty table. Children prove before parents.
traces_to: Law 6 via parent 2b3d842bc118 (codemother owns her learning); Law 7 (the served payload names the tree it walked); RULE 1 (the reader's change lives in skills/chart).
how: OWNER = 'codemother' in skills/chart/live.py; _counsel's owner defaults to it and the printed JSON carries 'owner'; the docstring's default line follows. Red-first proof skills/chart/proofs/test_live_counsel_reads_codemothers_tree.py.

clauses.claim: a node deposited into a codemother-owned scratch nexus is in the walk `live counsel <request> <nexus>` prints with no owner named
the served payload carries owner 'codemother' by default and 'chart' when argv names it, and the named walk sees a chart-owned node

decisions.text: D1: red-first proof skills/chart/proofs/test_live_counsel_reads_codemothers_tree.py, one tooth per clause; the bus legs (_embed, _drain_before_serving) stubbed on the module, the tree read real; scratch nexi via tree.scratch_nexus, and any chart_<scratch>_nodes a red run mints is dropped; red 3/3 at HEAD 2026-11-06.

D2: module-level OWNER = 'codemother' in skills/chart/live.py; _counsel: kw = {'owner': argv[2] if len(argv) > 2 else OWNER}; the printed JSON gains "owner": kw['owner']; the docstring line 'default is chart's own nexi' becomes 'default is codemother's own nexi'.

measured.saw: kw = {"owner": argv[2]} if len(argv) > 2 else {} in skills/chart/live.py _counsel; tree.OWNER = "chart"
measured.how: read skills/chart/live.py and cairn/tools/tree/tree.py; the red-first proof: all three teeth FAIL at HEAD 2026-11-06
